ops.title: Keep live lander halt intent recoverable until SIGTERM is sent
ops.description:
Owner: drive-lock coordinator (caller).
Next executable step: persist a recoverable pending-stop intent and let later halt passes finish it; do not turn the running lander into a completed hold before the signal is delivered.
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lib/drive/land.py:422 records the hold outcome, state.update commits it at :429, and os.killpg is deferred until :447. running() requires outcome=None and landing() excludes hold outcomes (:188-202), so a halter that dies after the commit but before the signal leaves the real lander alive and every subsequent held_landings() call skips it. The old version signalled before saving the hold.
Static review only; no tests run.

ops.text: A caller dying after the state commit but before SIGTERM leaves a stop request that a later halt pass retries.
Halt signals only a verified actual lander process group, never a claim owner's group.
